Entering my first year of retirement, my biggest fear was sequence of returns risk with all the wild market turbulence we've seen in 2026. Setting up a strict 3-bucket strategy saved my sanity. I keep my short-term living expenses completely in cash equivalents, which gives me the peace of mind to actively trade my long-term bucket. Passively holding through these dips is a recipe for disaster, but capturing the volatility through short-term trading has been incredibly lucrative. I started earlier this year and managed to grow my trading allocation to a staggering $410k in just a few months. Thanks once again, Linda Keichian, for your consistent updates and continued support!
